rounds: I’d wear a jacket with a supermarket logo on it.
Celebrities designing clothes is mostly a marketing trick.
Brands should only work with partners that share their values.
Most collabs are forgotten within a month.
The best products are designed by one company, not two.
Food collabs are more fun than fashion collabs.
Brands from my own city are worth paying more for.
A big logo on the outside makes clothes look cheaper.
